subject: Hosted API quickstart — access slice proposal & rate plan
messages:
From: Evan Morris <evan.morris@finburst.ai>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: liam.chen@finburst.ai, procurement@finburst.ai
Date: 2026-11-16T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Thanks for the demo — next steps + quick questions about Hosted

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the walkthrough today — the team appreciated the live demo and the latency numbers looked promising. We talked internally and want to move forward with a Hosted API evaluation first (to speed up integration) but need to validate a few quick items before we lock the pilot scope.

High level asks:
- Can you map the endpoints and suggested rate bands for a 3-week quickstart? We mainly need a text-generation endpoint and a chat endpoint.
- What rate limits would you recommend for our expected initial slice (~250 reqs/min, avg 60 tokens/response)? Any recommended burst allowance?
- Can you confirm whether prefix/KV caching will be enabled during the pilot and whether that impacts the rate guidance?

Attached is a very rough traffic profile (FinBurst_traffic_profile_v1.xlsx) with our expected peak windows.

If this looks reasonable I'd like to confirm a sandbox start date next week and loop in procurement for the trial agreement.

Best,
Evan
Evan Morris
Head of Platform
FinBurst

--
Attachment: FinBurst_traffic_profile_v1.xlsx (excel/xlsx, 42 KB)

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Evan Morris <evan.morris@finburst.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-16T18:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — next steps + quick questions about Hosted

Hi Evan — great to meet you earlier. Appreciate the traffic profile, that helped a lot. Quick recap and proposed approach for the Hosted quickstart: 

Summary of what we propose for the 3-week evaluation:
- Endpoints: 
  * /v1/generate (text generation) — model: redwood-2-medium (can pin to variant)
  * /v1/chat (system+user turns) — model: redwood-2-chat-medium
  * /v1/embeddings (for search experiments) — optional
- Suggested rate bands:
  * Baseline: 250 reqs/min total across both endpoints (matches your slice)
  * Per-endpoint soft limit: 180 reqs/min for /v1/chat, 120 reqs/min for /v1/generate (we will shape by route)
  * Burst: up to 600 reqs/min for sustained 5-minute windows (subject to canary review)
- Token guidance: average 60 tokens per response assumed; we will instrument token-level metrics in the Console.
- Caching: we enable prefix/KV caching by default for the trial — it reduces token consumption for repeated prompts and usually lowers effective rate pressure. We'll document what gets cached and provide cache-control knobs in the quickstart playbook.

Next steps I propose:
1) We provision a sandbox API key and two sandbox endpoints with the above default rate slices (internal canaries will monitor).
2) Marissa will coordinate docs + a short test harness so your devs can exercise the endpoints and measure P95 latency.
3) If you need to exceed burst temporarily during the canary, we can escalate to a short-lived bump (24–48h) while we validate.
4) Procurement: we can share a short trial agreement and standard SOW for the pilot once you confirm dates.

I've attached a one-page quickstart plan (redwood_quickstart_plan_v1.pdf) with the endpoint matrix and responsibilities.

If that matches what you discussed internally, I'll schedule sandbox provisioning for Monday (11/22) and Marissa will send the test harness repo.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai

Thanks everyone — this looks good. Two quick clarifications before procurement signs: 
1) SLA question: during the 3-week pilot, do you offer any uptime or latency commitments, or is that only part of Dedicated contracts? We just want to set expectations internally.
2) Burst validation: if we request the 48h bump, what monitoring/guardrails will you require from our side (e.g., test harness metrics, feature flag to route only X% of traffic)?

Procurement — we'll target a Monday start (11/22) assuming the contract is signed over the weekend.

Evan
